title: Diff-DDoS: Realistic Cyber-Physical Attack Synthesis and Robust Detection for 5G-Enabled CPS Using Tabular Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17796v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning-based DDoS detectors for 5G-enabled cyber-physical systems face scarce labeled attack data and unrealistic synthetic substitutes, which limit robustness against adaptive adversaries. Detectors trained on hand-crafted attacks with fixed scaling multipliers degrade catastrophically (F1-score drops of about 47 percent to 100 percent, depending on scenario) when confronted with realistic, distribution-preserving samples. We propose Diff-DDoS, a three-phase framework for realistic attack synthesis and robust detection using tabular diffusion models. Phase 1 trains a baseline CNN cell-level detector on spatiotemporal grids from call detail records (CDRs). Phase 2 trains a tabular denoising diffusion probabilistic model (TabDDPM) on normal CDR aggregates to generate realistic attacks and expose detector vulnerabilities. translated_title: Diff-DDoS：基于表格扩散模型的5G使能信息物理系统现实网络物理攻击合成与稳健检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17796v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于深度学习的5G使能信息物理系统DDoS检测器面临标注攻击数据稀缺和不现实的合成替代品，这限制了对自适应对手的稳健性。在手工制作、具有固定缩放因子的攻击上训练的检测器，在面对现实、保持分布一致的样本时，性能会严重下降（根据场景不同，F1分数下降约47%至100%）。我们提出Diff-DDoS，一个三阶段框架，用于使用表格扩散模型进行现实攻击合成和稳健检测。第一阶段在来自呼叫详细记录（CDRs）的时空网格上训练基线CNN单元级检测器。第二阶段在正常CDR聚合上训练表格去噪扩散概率模型（TabDDPM），以生成现实攻击并暴露检测器漏洞。第三阶段引入对抗扩散训练（ADT），使用逆分类器指导生成困难样本。
tldr: 提出Diff-DDoS框架，利用表格扩散模型生成现实攻击样本，并通过对抗扩散训练增强DDoS检测器对自适应攻击的稳健性，显著提升F1分数。
en_tdlr: Diff-DDoS framework uses tabular diffusion models to synthesize realistic attacks and employs adversarial diffusion training to enhance DDoS detector robustness against adaptive adversaries, significantly improving F1 scores.
